name: True Polymorph — the copy picker leaves out shroud and an opponent's hexproof
notes: 2026-11-17. "… becomes a copy of another target artifact or creature": what is copied is a target, but the copy picker (getCopyCandidates) never asked about shroud, hexproof or protection. A copy of a target now carries params.sourceTargeted (cards-parser.js, copy section) and the picker checks them as the target pickers do. Your own hexproof creature stays.
